Write the SMILES representations of products A and B in the reactions below, given that B contains a five-membered aromatic ring. 10-2-2 Label the absolute configurations of all chiral carbon atoms in the structure of A from the preceding question.

subquestions.text_open: 10-2-3 Write the SMILES representation of another electrically neutral key intermediate Y, other than the type-X intermediate, involved in formation of B.
10-2-4 If an appropriate amount of CH_{2}=CHCO_{2}Me is added to the reaction system that forms B, Y is trapped to form two products, C_{1} and C_{2}. Write their SMILES representations.

subquestions.text_open: 10-3-2 In the presence of Et_{3}N, EtO_{2}CCOCl, CyNC, P(Oi-Pr)_{3}, NCCH_{2}CN, and CS_{2} undergo a multicomponent reaction in MeCN. Write the SMILES representation of product D.

10-4 Under certain conditions, an α-carbonyl diazo compound can replace an acyl chloride in a similar reaction with an isocyanide. Write the SMILES representations of all intermediates and products in the scheme below. W and all three products contain a five-membered ring, but only the five-membered ring in E is aromatic; F also contains a six-membered ring.

text_images.description: A synthetic reaction scheme: '[R1]C(C(C([R1])=O)=[N+]=[N-])=O' is the starting material and is converted by an arrow to Z. Intermediate Z then reacts with `R_2NC` to form W. Intermediate **W** branches into three transformations: the upper branch reacts with `MeNHNH_2` to form E; the middle branch reacts with '[R1]C(C([R1])=O)=C=O' to form F; and the lower branch forms H under H^+ conditions.
